notes: A227145.A227145_conjecture: every a : Z -> Z with a n = 0 (n <= 1) and a n = n - 1 - sum_{i=1..n} a^[i] (n - i) (n >= 2) has a (fib m) = fib (m - 2) for m >= 2; exists_solution, eq_C (uniqueness). Route: the word w = 0 sig(w), sig k = (k+1) 0^(k+1); c n = #nonzero letters in w_0..w_(n-1); block tiling (w_block, cover, block_unique), c_iter_step (c^j(u+1) - c^j(u) = [j <= w u]), coverage (exactly one block reaches a zero position), rec_nat/C_rec (c solves the recurrence), fib_odd_step/fib_even_step (st(F_(2k+1)) = F_(2k+3) + 1, st(F_(2k+2)) = F_(2k+4)). Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none (data terms checked by certificate/check_A227145.py only).

sources.cite: M. Celaya, F. Ruskey, Morphic words and nested recurrence relations, arXiv:1307.0153, Prop. 10
